note: The donor-hardware session, as gates a script can check. Nothing here claims a run works: it checks that a captured log proves what the plan says it proves, and it refuses to score a log as hardware evidence when it cannot tell.

log_shape.active_app: \AD102-UNLOCK\RUNnnnn.TXT on the USB stick, one file per boot, never overwritten
log_shape.read_only_diagnostic: \GPU-TOPOLOGY-DIAGNOSTIC-nnnn.TXT at the root of the USB stick
log_shape.line_endings: the diagnostic writes CRLF; the active app writes LF. Both are accepted
log_shape.order: the file number is the boot order; pass the logs to the verifier in that order

stages.title: Read-only contact
stages.what_it_costs: nothing: the diagnostic never writes a GPU register, resets a Falcon, calls the vendor Stop or loads firmware
stages.exit: the card is enumerated, its BDF and PCI identity are in the log, and the eligibility flags are printed as false
stages.build_note: the read-only image always saves its numbered log; add -WindowsEspGuid '<reviewed GUID>' only if you want the automatic Windows handover

stages.title: Preparation only
stages.what_it_costs: the active app runs its preflight and preparation, logs a refusal before any mutation, and hands back to Windows
stages.exit: preparation completes with MUTATION_AUTHORIZED=0 and no Stop, no waiver and no step line
stages.build_note: a selection without -EnableSingleTargetExecution and without the waiver compiles the preparation-only image (GPU-ACTIVE-PREP-*), which refuses to actuate before it starts

stages.title: Waived actuation
stages.what_it_costs: the one admission that may write: a single card, ordered, no retry, with the firmware timer bounded or explicitly off
stages.exit: the waiver is recorded once, the pre-Stop contract is captured, the step reaches a terminal record, and the next boot reads the record it left
stages.build_note: the only waiver switch; it also needs a reviewed local/boot_profile.h or -RuntimeEsp, and the matched assets on the ESP

gates.title: the read-only image ran

requires.token: GPU TOPOLOGY DIAGNOSTIC ONLY - no GPU hardware writes or unlock calls
requires.why: the banner is printed before any observation, so its presence is the cheapest proof that this build and not another one ran

forbids.why: a read-only session must not contain the waiver admission, which only the actuating build prints
the Stop contract is captured inside the release path; its presence means a Stop was attempted, which no read-only run does

gates.proves: the read-only diagnostic started and wrote its own log
gates.does_not_prove: that the enumeration below finished, or anything about the card

gates.title: the inventory finished without a vendor callback

requires.why: printed once the display and bridge scan has counted its handles, with the count in the line
the driver-owner inventory is the part that says which image owns the card, and it is explicitly not provenance
the eligibility flags are printed as false, so the log itself states the session could not detach or unlock

forbids.why: a partial enumeration is not an inventory; the failure line means some handle could not be read

gates.proves: the scan reached its end and reported counts, with eligibility explicitly false
gates.does_not_prove: that the card is in a state any later stage could use

gates.title: at least one NVIDIA card is named

requires_any.why: the driver-owner line carries BDF, driver binding and opener state for one card
the active-app inventory line carries BDF and PCI identity for one card

gates.proves: the run is about a real card with an address and an identity, not an empty machine
gates.does_not_prove: that the identity matches the donor card the operator recorded by hand

gates.title: the app refused to actuate and said so first

requires.why: printed by the preparation-only entrypoint before any transaction, so the session is bounded by the entrypoint and not by luck
preparation reached its end with mutation explicitly unauthorized

forbids.why: a step that may write must not appear in a preparation session
no Stop may be attempted in a preparation session

gates.proves: the entrypoint refused actuation and the preflight completed
gates.does_not_prove: that the preflight's conclusions are right; the counts say what was selected, not what was safe

gates.title: the persistent record was read before anything else

requires_any.token: BOOT_STATE PRESENT=1 PHASE=%u BOOT_COUNT=%u STATUS=%#llx DEVICE=%04x
requires_any.why: a record from an earlier boot was found and decoded
no record was found, which is the correct state for the first boot on a wiped machine

gates.proves: the record path works on this machine, in one of its two honest states
gates.does_not_prove: that the record can be written, or that it survives a power loss; that needs a run that is interrupted

gates.title: the waiver is in this boot's log, exactly once

requires.why: the waiver is a boot-level decision: more than one occurrence means a retry or a second entrypoint, which the plan forbids
names the waiver the diff admits, so the log cannot be mistaken for a verified build

forbids.why: a simulator run prints SIMULATED instead of WAIVED_UNVERIFIED; if both appear the log is not a clean hardware record

gates.proves: an actuating image reached its admission exactly once
gates.does_not_prove: that the admission was safe; the waiver is the reason it is not

gates.title: the pre-Stop capture exists and names what it is missing

requires.token: STOP_CONTRACT device=%04x stage=%zu OWNER=%d COLD=%d CONSOLE=%d PEERS=%d
requires.why: the capture names the device, the stage and the four observations that just held; the rest of the line is the requirements
the same line ends with the decision and the missing set, so a capture that found nothing missing cannot be confused with one that did

gates.proves: the image captured its pre-Stop state and stated which requirements it cannot establish
gates.does_not_prove: that any of the six unobservable facts hold - by construction they are the ones this image cannot see

gates.title: the step that may write began, in order

requires.why: the only line printed immediately before a card may be written

gates.proves: an ordered step was admitted after every preflight
gates.does_not_prove: how the step ended; that is the next gate

gates.title: the step reached a terminal record instead of the log ending

requires_any.why: the step completed and peer state was re-observed
the coordinator halted deliberately and promised no successor; this is a legitimate ending, not a failure

requires_any.token: STOP: stage=%s status=%#llx mutated=%u retained=%u fault=%u
requires_any.why: the application recorded the transaction result, including whether the card was mutated, retained or faulted

gates.proves: the log ends at a decision the image recorded itself, so truncation is distinguishable from an ending
gates.does_not_prove: that the ending was a good one; HALTED passes this gate on purpose

gates.title: a later boot read the record this run left

requires.token: BOOT_STATE PRESENT=1 PHASE=%u BOOT_COUNT=%u STATUS=%#llx DEVICE=%04x
requires.why: the state that is supposed to survive a failed boot is only proved by a boot that comes after it

gates.proves: the record survived whatever the actuation did, and a later boot could read it
gates.does_not_prove: that the record was correct, or that the machine came back warm rather than through a power cycle

advisories.why: the application prints whether the firmware timer is armed or deliberately off. The DXE entrypoint does not print this, so it is a note rather than a gate
every boot now records where it started from and, when it refuses, which gate failed
says whether a bundle was ever staged on the stick, before discovery assumes anything about assets

manual_gates.title: the physical recovery path is on the bench before the first run
manual_gates.why: an external programmer and a known-good firmware image are the only way back from a card that no longer answers; they cannot be fetched afterwards
manual_gates.record: the programmer model, the image digest, and the SPI flash part number, noted in the session log

manual_gates.title: the donor card's identity is written down before the run
manual_gates.why: the log will name a BDF and a device ID; without the card's serial and the slot it was in, those cannot be tied to a piece of silicon afterwards
manual_gates.record: serial number, slot, board model, the VBIOS version the vendor tool reports

manual_gates.title: the log medium starts empty
manual_gates.why: RUN0001.TXT must be this boot, or a stale file is indistinguishable from a live one and the gate verdicts describe the wrong run
manual_gates.record: a directory listing of the stick before the boot, photographed or copied

manual_gates.title: exactly one NVIDIA card, no peers
manual_gates.why: the waived path admits ordered single steps; a second card changes which gates apply and has never been exercised
manual_gates.record: the R2 inventory line, which must show one NVIDIA driver owner

manual_gates.title: a HALTED step ends the day, not the loop
manual_gates.why: no retry is a property of the image; re-running after a halt is the operator reintroducing the risk the image refused
manual_gates.record: the halt line, and the decision to stop, in the session log

manual_gates.title: Windows is started normally with the card enumerated after every run
manual_gates.why: the log cannot see Windows; device start, driver binding and a display output have to be observed by a person
manual_gates.record: the Windows build, the driver version, and the device status in Device Manager

never_established_by_a_log.why: no code in this tree observes the Windows 617.42 Booter; the comparison is external evidence that has to be produced separately and has never been produced
the Stop contract's TARGET_GOP requirement is never observed - the image does not read the target's firmware GOP ownership
the contract's LOG requirement needs the log closed before the Stop; the image cannot close the file it is writing to
no recovery procedure has been executed on this card, so the requirement stays false no matter what the log shows
the vendor Stop callback has no measured worst-case duration; a log line that shows it returned says nothing about how long it could take
the contract's DMA requirement is not observable here; bus-master state is checked, engine idleness is not
the log ends at the handover; whether Windows started the device is only visible in Windows
a benchmark number is a measurement on a machine, not a property of this source
the state after cutting power mid-transaction has never been observed, and a clean run says nothing about it
